item.title: This Software is Faster Than Adobe Lightroom
item.description: Every photographer knows this feeling. You get home after a full day of shooting, sit down, open Lightroom, and watch each thumbnail slowly appear on your screen one by one like your time means nothing. And that's before you've even started culling through hundreds, sometimes thousands of frames to find the keepers. For working photographers on deadlines and enthusiasts who'd rather be shooting, that wait adds up fast. That’s where Photoculler comes in.
